integrity: Proof is independent of finite computations; supplemental checker uses exact rational and numerical finite tests. Bibliographic novelty not independently certified.
limitations: Sharp coefficient Hilbert-space stability for a selected polynomial factor, not a factor-independent stability of arbitrary nonnegative trigonometric polynomials; no consequences claimed for complete Krzyz conjecture. Potential equivalent older Green-function spectra remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact spectrum and sharp coefficient stability for the Fejér pointwise inequality
